architecture_reference.oceanic_branch: Derive a conductive oceanic surface heat-flow field from governed ocean age using a pinned finite-plate model, only on valid support.
architecture_reference.join: Use physical_crust_domain_id categorically; preserve UNKNOWN, lineage, and branch-specific uncertainty; never blend domain values.
architecture_reference.runtime_authority: A complete global field is replayable derived T0 state. FEG serialization is runtime support only.

internal_qarray_age_route.active_condition: needQ = (heatFl == 0); OrbData5 requests qArray when any nodal dQdTdA/heatFl is exactly zero.
internal_qarray_age_route.selected_path: INACTIVE only if every serialized node is an explicit valid nonzero value. A missing/unknown node must stop qualification rather than invoke fallback.
internal_qarray_age_route.age_zero_assignment: The qualified Assign age<=0 -> qLim1 assignment is inside needQ and therefore bypassed by explicit nonzero heatFl. This does not make qLim1 inactive as a general ceiling.

explicit_nonzero_input_effects.pre_assign_limits: OrbData5 applies qLimit=qLim0+dQL_dE*elevation to nonzero values and then caps all values at qLim1.
explicit_nonzero_input_effects.assign_limits: Assign reapplies the floor and ceiling; conditional geotherm-consistency corrections can change heatFl and then reapply the limits.
explicit_nonzero_input_effects.qualified_runtime_effect_size: UNKNOWN until a future separately authorized FAIR execution records before/after values.

ocean_model.production_model_selection: UNRESOLVED; no exact ARCANA production model/version is defensible from current authority alone.
ocean_model.model_family: FINITE_THICKNESS_PLATE_COOLING (already selected by the architecture closure)

leading_literature_candidate.paper: Holdt et al. (2025), Revised Oceanic Plate Cooling Models, JGR: Solid Earth, DOI 10.1029/2024JB029890
leading_literature_candidate.governing_equation: H(t) = k (T - T0) / zp * [1 + 2 sum(i=1..N, exp(-kappa*i^2*pi^2*t/zp^2))], kappa=k/(rho_m*Cp).
leading_literature_candidate.units: H in W m-2; k in W m-1 K-1; T,T0 in K or temperature difference K; zp in m; kappa in m2 s-1; t in seconds in the equation (ocean age input in Ma must be converted); rho_m in kg m-3; Cp in J kg-1 K-1.

k.uncertainty: model study reports a parameter fit; ARCANA transfer range not established

alpha.role: thermal expansivity for the coupled plate model; not directly in the heat-flow equation above

T.role: basal mantle temperature in the published reference model
T.uncertainty: paper reports joint-fit/model uncertainty; ARCANA transfer range not established

zp.uncertainty: paper reports joint-fit/model uncertainty; ARCANA transfer range not established

zr.role: ridge depth for coupled subsidence fit; not an input to H(t) alone

candidate_assumptions_and_limits: 1-D conduction in a horizontally translating plate with constant properties for the analytical HWR-2 form.
Conductive surface heat flow, not total conductive-plus-hydrothermal ocean heat loss.
Finite plate thickness/basal heat resupply gives mature/old-age flattening; unlike half-space cooling, it does not continue cooling indefinitely.
The model is calibrated against modern-Earth depth and heat-flow data; this is not ARCANA 210 Ma observational authority.
Holdt et al. describe HWR-2 and variable-property HWR-3 as similarly supported; HWR-3 may better represent thermal structure. This leaves structural-model choice open.
The analytical series is singular as t approaches zero; a finite truncation is numerical series convergence, not a physical ridge regularization.

comparison_candidates.role: published variable-property alternative; comparable fit, different material complexity
historical empirical plate relation; ShellSet source lineage
young-age conductive limiting/reference model; continued cooling at old age

valid_age_domain.mathematical: HWR-2 equation is finite for positive age; the t=0 limit is singular. Its published fit/applicability is tied to the study's modern-Earth observations and model assumptions, not an established ARCANA domain.
valid_age_domain.arcana: No ARCANA age validity interval is authorized yet. Do not extrapolate into unresolved young/rift support or claim Earth calibration validates the synthetic age-to-boundary-distance field.

ocean_model.parameter_transfer_rationale: TARGETED_RESEARCH_REQUIRED: establish whether the B-v2 Earth-like authored realization warrants transfer of an Earth-calibrated cooling law, which model form, and which parameter uncertainty/covariance. The GDH1 bathymetry model identity does not itself authorize a heat-flow law.

age_zero.policy: Keep heat-flow output UNKNOWN at age==0 until a separately governed finite ridge/accretion model is selected. Never substitute qLim1 as physical output.

positive_very_young.policy: Fail closed where the selected model's young-age applicability has not been justified. No numerical cutoff is selected.

ridge_rift.policy: No separate branch selected; preserve UNKNOWN until finite-width/accretion and any advective/hydrothermal scope are governed.

young_ocean_policy.hydrothermal: No universal scalar correction is authorized. Any claim must distinguish measured conductive flux from total advective-plus-conductive loss and represent the heterogeneous young-crust process.

distinctions.PHYSICAL_MODEL_OUTPUT: Positive-age output of a selected, in-domain cooling law; none is yet authorized for ARCANA.
distinctions.PHYSICAL_REGULARIZATION: None selected; a series cutoff, clamp, or qLim cap is not a physical ridge solution.
distinctions.MODEL_DOMAIN_UNKNOWN: Selected fail-closed policy for unsupported age-zero, young, and ridge/rift values.
distinctions.NUMERICAL_RUNTIME_GUARD: ShellSet qLim values are runtime guards/configuration and must not be reinterpreted as physical model output.

qlim_governance.source_status: Compiled PARAMETER constants in the qualified OrbData5 source, not user parameter-file bindings.

qLim0.current_effect_for_positive_flux: With qualified zero floor and zero slope, nonnegative positive producer values are not changed by this floor; negative values would be raised. This conditional statement does not qualify post-correction values or another source build.
qLim0.governance: Must be explicitly accepted with diagnostics or proved nonbinding over the full valid input and correction range; otherwise separately reviewed source/configuration change and requalification.

dQL_dE.operation: Sets elevation dependence of the lower bound qLimit=qLim0+dQL_dE*elevation.
dQL_dE.current_effect_for_positive_flux: Current compiled slope is zero, so elevation does not change the floor. No ARCANA physical elevation law is implied.
dQL_dE.governance: Same as qLim0; no ARCANA value/range selected.

qLim1.operation: Upper bound heatFl=MIN(heatFl,qLim1), applied before Assign and again after conditional corrections; also used by internal age<=0 fill only in needQ branch.
qLim1.governance: Cannot be treated as inactive for the selected path. The 0.3 W m-2 cap may clip a governed model output; demonstrate non-binding for every valid T0 input and correction or require separately reviewed source/configuration change and requalification. Do not call it a physical upper bound.

qlim_governance.decision: NO qLim control is silently accepted as a harmless pass-through. Their qualification requires before/after field evidence and an explicit governance decision; qLim1 makes current non-mutating runtime unproven.

producer_parameter_contract.schema_version: NOT_ISSUED; requires exact model, transfer rationale, and young applicability decision first.

producer_parameter_contract.producer_and_orbdata_parameter_separatio: Ocean cooling k/Cp/temperature/thickness belong to the heat-flow producer only unless governance explicitly binds them to OrbData's material properties as the same physical quantities. No implicit copying/binding is authorized.

orbdata_thermal_configuration.status: UNRESOLVED_SPECIALIST_CONFIGURATION; no ARCANA material parameters selected.
orbdata_thermal_configuration.evidence_boundary: The qualified extraction proves these are runtime inputs/call-site controls. Values in INPUT/iEarth5-049.in are Earth example defaults, not ARCANA authority or candidate selections.

projection_contract.target: 64,442 FEG nodes; support generation remains an implementation blocker until canonical partition/mesh payload is available.
projection_contract.existing_adapter: project_cell_field_to_nodes records incident cells and deterministic selection; continuous fields use lexicographically first incident cell, categorical values require unanimous known incident agreement, and UNKNOWN incident support is preserved.
projection_contract.gap: The generic continuous projector alone does not couple heat-flow selection to unanimous physical_crust_domain_id and continental thermal-class support. It can select a first incident cell at mixed support. The current heat-flow field is not yet projected/bound through a field-aware policy.
projection_contract.required_change: Add/use a heat-flow-specific gate: first require homogeneous, known physical-domain and (on continental branch) thermal-class support; only then project branch value and retain all incident source IDs plus selected value lineage. Mixed domain/class, any UNKNOWN input, and unsupported age applicability remain UNKNOWN. Never average or smooth across branch classes.
projection_contract.projection_authority: NUMERICAL_DERIVED_SUPPORT_ONLY; no increase in physical resolution.

uncertainty_contract.continental_authored_field: Preserve authored thermal-class provenance; no numerical uncertainty distribution exists, so do not invent one. Metadata plus separately governed sensitivity requirement.
uncertainty_contract.ocean_structural_model: Keep HWR-2/HWR-3/GDH1 or other alternatives as distinct model-form alternatives; ensemble if they change downstream decisions or outputs.
uncertainty_contract.ocean_parameters: Use literature-backed joint/correlated ranges only after transfer is justified; bounded sensitivity or targeted ensemble, not independent arbitrary sampling.
uncertainty_contract.young_rift_applicability: Separate applicability uncertainty; unsupported values remain UNKNOWN. Compare an explicit ridge/accretion branch only after it is defined.
uncertainty_contract.projection_support: Track categorical agreement, source-cell IDs, support coverage, UNKNOWN counts, and convergence/error evidence; numerical error bound currently absent.
uncertainty_contract.orbdata_material_geotherm: Keep material/geotherm parameter uncertainty separate from producer uncertainty; correlated bounded sensitivity by material family, with ensembles only for consequential combinations.
